name: TPLeo APAP
author: leoquorum

sections.description:
TPLeo APAP is a setup assistant that centralizes access to the most important WordPress configuration pages and recommended tools for launching a new website.

It provides an organized checklist covering:

  • Basic WordPress settings
  • Global design options
  • Dynamic content configuration
  • Recommended plugins
  • Useful web tools for designers and developers

The plugin does not modify your website automatically. Instead, it guides you through each configuration step by providing direct access to the appropriate WordPress admin pages and external resources.

Features

  • Organized setup checklist
  • Quick access to WordPress settings
  • Direct links to recommended plugins
  • Useful tools for SEO, design and optimization
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • No automatic changes to your website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open TPLeo APAP from the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin install other plugins automatically?

No. TPLeo APAP only provides quick access to the installation pages of recommended plugins and useful configuration screens.

Does this plugin modify my website settings?

No. The plugin does not change any settings automatically. It simply helps you navigate the configuration process more efficiently.
